en.headline: JUPAS: 287 of 453 applicants succeed in reconsideration after DSE review
en.dek: Sixty-three per cent of those who sought a fresh look after rechecking results received an offer or a higher-preference programme; 83 students who had none previously gained a place.
body: The Joint University Programmes Admissions System office announced on Thursday morning that 287 of the 453 applicants who requested reconsideration based on upgraded HKDSE results after rechecking and remarking had succeeded, a success rate of 63.4 per cent.

Among them, 204 students who already held a main-round offer were given a higher-priority degree programme. A further 83 applicants who received no offer in the main round on 5 August were newly admitted to a UGC-funded bachelor’s programme, Hong Kong Metropolitan University bachelor’s programme or an SSSDP-funded degree.

Successful applicants must accept the offer or “better” offer and pay the acceptance fee by 5 pm today. Once a higher-preference offer is issued the original main-round place is withdrawn immediately, regardless of whether the student has already paid the deposit or completed registration.

zh.headline: 聯招覆核後重新考慮結果公布 287人成功佔六成三
zh.dek: 453名申請人中287人獲取錄或較高次序課程，成功率63.4%；83人由原先未獲派學位變為獲取錄。
body: 大學聯合招生處周四上午公布，根據文憑試成績覆核後更高科目等級重新考慮入學申請的遴選結果。本年度共有453名申請人遞交要求，較去年增加約2.5%，其中287人成功，佔63.4%，高於去年的58.6%。
成功個案中，204名於正式遴選已獲學位課程取錄的申請人獲派較高次序的學位課程；另有83名原先未獲任何取錄資格的申請人，其後獲教資會資助學士學位、都會大學學士學位或指定專業／界別課程資助計劃學士學位取錄。
獲取錄資格或較高次序課程的申請人須於今日下午5時前透過聯招帳戶表示接納並繳交留位費。一經獲派較高次序課程，原有正式遴選取錄資格即時被撤回，不論是否已繳費或完成註冊。
